strategies.name: Bounded Non-PEAD Weak-Trend Gap-Up Short
strategies.universe_rule: US Common Stock, OCF_TTM > $0, Price ≥ $15, 20d ADTV ≥ $10M (ETB)
strategies.signal_rule: Open < SMA20 AND +1.30 ≤ z_gap ≤ +2.80 (rejects > +2.8σ PEAD/M&A beats); +6% stop
strategies.hedge_rule: Buy β_20d × Notional in SPY at 09:30; flatten both at Close
strategies.structural_why: Retail overnight limit-buy orders chase headlines into structurally broken charts (Open < SMA20), while institutional Execution-Shortfall VWAP sell programs wait for RTH depth to distribute.
strategies.placebo_note: Gaps > +3.5σ (true earnings/M&A PEAD) reverse sign and lose money to short; bounding z_gap ≤ +2.8σ isolates non-news retail overreaction.

strategies.name: SEC Rule 10b-18 Buyback-Shutoff / MOC Vacuum
strategies.hedge_rule: Short 1.0 × Notional in SPY at 15:55; unwind both next day at 10:00 AM ET
strategies.structural_why: SEC Rule 10b-18(b)(2)(ii) forces corporate buyback desks to pull bids during the final 10–30m of RTH just as passive/risk-parity MOC sells hit, creating an artificial air-pocket that snaps back when 10b-18 bids turn back on at 09:35–10:00 AM.
strategies.placebo_note: Exact same 15:00–15:55 drop on non-buyback small-caps / cash-burners delivers -15.3 bps/trade (t = -0.59) — proving corporate Rule 10b-18 buyback resumption is the causal engine.

strategies.name: 2x/3x Leveraged ETP Constant-Leverage 15:55 Washout
strategies.universe_rule: Liquid 2x/3x Single-Stock & Sector Leveraged ETPs (20d ADTV ≥ $15M)
strategies.signal_rule: z1d_c ≤ -1.50σ AND IBS ≤ 0.15 (pinned in bottom 15% of day's range at 15:55)
strategies.hedge_rule: Unhedged overnight rebound capture; exit strictly at 09:30–09:35 AM Open
strategies.structural_why: Constant-leverage ETP swap desks have structural negative gamma (ΔRebal = L(L-1)·AUM·r) and are contractually forced to dump underlying delta into 15:50–16:00 NAV fixings on trend down-days.
strategies.placebo_note: Only fires when crushed into the final bell (IBS ≤ 0.15); midday ETP dips without 15:55 rebalance pressure show zero edge.

strategies.name: Biotech $5+ Bounded Non-News Stop-Run Gap Reversal
strategies.signal_rule: prev_rvol ≤ 1.5x AND -3.00 ≤ ind_gap_z ≤ -1.20 (excludes < -3σ clinical/S-3 crashes); -10% stop
strategies.hedge_rule: Short β_20d × Notional in SPY at 09:30; cap clip ≤ 0.5% ADTV; exit Close
strategies.structural_why: Thin premarket books in $5+ institutional biotechs let tiny retail/margin stop-runs gap shares down -4% to -9% with zero press release; specialist pods refill the vacuum once RTH opens, whereas < -3σ gaps are toxic Phase 3 failures or overnight ATM offerings.
strategies.placebo_note: Directly solves the SLS failure mode: bounding ind_gap_z ≥ -3.0, Open ≥ $5, and prev_rvol ≤ 1.5x eliminates S-3 dilution waterfalls.

strategies.name: S&P 500 1-of-N Narrow-Industry Capitulation Shock
strategies.universe_rule: S&P 500 Member, Close ≥ $20, 20d ADTV ≥ $25M, ≥ 6 Narrow-Industry Peers
strategies.signal_rule: ind_resid_z ≤ -2.50σ (isolated vs narrow peers), RVOL ≥ 2.5x, IBS ≤ 0.25
strategies.hedge_rule: 1/3 of sleeve per daily cohort; mandatory index constituency prevents terminal bankruptcy
strategies.structural_why: Active pod-shop risk managers enforce mechanical drawdown liquidations into the close when a single S&P 500 constituent suffers an isolated 2.5σ+ selloff while its narrow industry peers stay flat; mandatory S&P index passive inflows absorb the exhausted supply over T+1..T+3.
strategies.placebo_note: Market-wide selloffs (where industry peers also drop) are automatically rejected because ind_resid_z stays near 0.

sls_case_study.verdict: Optical Reclaim Illusion: SLS reclaims its 09:30 open 69.8% of the time on small dips, but capping upside at the open while eating -8% to -15% uncapped ATM shelf-offering liquidation days + $0.01 Reg NMS tick drag (~46.5 bps RT at $4.30) turns it strongly negative (-40.1 to -80.6 bps/trade). Upgrading to S4 ($5+ floor, bounded -1.2σ..-3.0σ industry gap, quiet prior RVOL ≤ 1.5x) converts biotech dislocations into +172.6 bps/trade net.

graveyard.family: Paired 2x/3x Bull + Bear Leveraged ETP Volatility Decay Short
graveyard.why_failed: Hard-to-borrow fees (8–25% annualized on 3x inverse/single-stock ETPs) plus path-dependent trending weeks completely eat theoretical daily variance drag.

graveyard.family: Closed-End Fund (CEF) Extreme Selloff / NAV Mean Reversion
graveyard.why_failed: Wide 35–85 bps quoted spreads and $1M–$3M thin retail books turn statistical bounces deeply negative after realistic execution.
Duration shocks and specialist spread widening during rate spikes overwhelm small par-reversion edges.

graveyard.family: 11:30 AM ET European Close ADR / Multinational Reversal
graveyard.why_failed: Real microstructure effect (~11 bps gross), but modern cross-border stat-arb pods have compressed it inside Reg NMS spread + slippage.

graveyard.family: Unbounded Overnight Gap Fades (> 3.5σ Gaps Up or Down)
graveyard.why_failed: Extreme gaps (> 3σ) contain true information (earnings PEAD, M&A, FDA Phase 3 failures, S-3 offerings) that drift in the gap direction all day.
Selecting top 'habitual morning dippers' in Train (+62.6 bps) completely inverts Out-of-Sample (-34.5 bps net) once corporate ATM/VWAP programs finish.
Profitable on FISV/PLNT/NU (+33 bps corrected), but across 245 other stocks intraday VWAP dips lack active corporate buyback absorption.
